ideas.pitch: A lightweight onboard telemetry and post-flight analysis tool for custom racing drones to optimize lap times and battery health.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Drone Race: Design, build, and pilot a custom drone through a timed obstacle course, demonstrating speed, maneuverability, precision, and responsible flight control.
ideas.title: AeroTelemetry: Real-Time FPV Drone Telemetry & Blackbox Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the need for precision and adjusted time by giving pilots immediate post-flight data insights to adjust their lines and motor usage between elimination rounds, mirroring winning hardware and IoT data feedback loops.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI computer vision gate sensor system that automatically logs drone crossing times during practice runs on the volleyball court course.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Drone Race: Design, build, and pilot a custom drone through a timed obstacle course, demonstrating speed, maneuverability, precision, and responsible flight control.
ideas.title: GateSnap: Automated Drone Obstacle Gate Timer and Lap Counter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact logistical challenge of manual timing during high-speed drone races with a working live hardware-software demo, following the winning pattern of unusual physical builds and live-tested setups.

ideas.pitch: An auxiliary hardware safety monitor that clips onto custom 450mm racing drones to track cell voltage drops, temperature spikes, and prevent catastrophic battery failures.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Drone Race: Pre-Competition Safety & Inspection - All drones must be successfully test-flown prior to the event; airworthiness inspection covering materials, workmanship, and radio installation.
ideas.title: VoltGuard: 6S LiPo Battery Health & Thermal Safety Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns perfectly with the strict pre-competition safety and airworthiness inspection guidelines, giving the verification committee confidence and standing out as a practical safety device.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-friendly configuration assistant that streamlines PID tuning and filter adjustments on the field right before race heats.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Drone Race: The course will be revealed at the venue, testing participants' ability to adapt on the spot.
ideas.title: AeroTune: PID Tuning Companion App for Custom FPV Quads
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the explicit need for rapid on-the-spot adaptation when the course layout is revealed at the venue, allowing teams to adjust flight profiles faster than opponents.

ideas.pitch: A quick inventory and checklist app tailored for the two-drone model limit and rapid part replacement rules during elimination rounds.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Drone Race: Each team may register and use up to 2 drone models, verified by the Inspection Committee; a damaged or lost drone may be replaced with a further model before the start time.
ideas.title: PropSwap: Quick-Swap Drone Component and Spares Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organizes the complex logistics of managing dual drone models and spare parts within tight event timelines, minimizing stress and administrative errors during intense tournament brackets.
